question: How is the thousand-headed million-liṅga honored in salutation?
premises: The deity is addressed as thousand-headed
The deity is addressed as million-liṅga
Obeisance is offered to this deity
inference: Obeisance is paid to the thousand-headed million-liṅga.
plain_english: Obeisance to the thousand-headed one; O million-liṅga, obeisance be to you.
